title: JSFL gaps: timeline range methods, setLayerProperty, getLayerProperty, selectAllFrames, testMovie
description:
Add missing JSFL surface to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts:

1. timeline.selectAllFrames(): set all frames on all layers as selected. Stub that sets state.selectedIds to all display objects in the current scene, or simply a no-op returning void.

2. timeline.convertToKeyframes(startFrame?, endFrame?): current impl only supports single frame. Extend to accept optional endFrame — when both provided, call coreInsertKeyframe for each frame in [startFrame, endFrame].

3. timeline.convertToBlankKeyframes(startFrame?, endFrame?): same as above — extend to loop from startFrame to endFrame calling coreInsertBlankKeyframe.

4. timeline.removeFrames(startFrame?, endFrame?): current impl takes (numFrames, startFrameIndex). Add overload support: when endFrame is provided, compute numFrames = endFrame - startFrame + 1 and call the existing implementation. Keep backwards compat.

5. doc.setLayerProperty(property: string, value: any): sets a property on the current/active layer. The active layer is state.layerIndex. Properties: 'name', 'locked', 'visible', 'layerType', 'color'. Call the appropriate core layer update function (like updateLayer or setLayerProperty from @flash/core).

6. doc.getLayerProperty(property: string): returns a property from the current layer. Same properties as setLayerProperty. Read from state.doc.scenes[state.sceneIndex].timeline.layers[state.layerIndex].

7. doc.testMovie(): console.warn stub, return void.

Add all 7 to their respective interfaces (JsflTimeline, JsflDocument) and makeTimelineProxy/makeDocumentProxy.
